facts.business: SNL Bearings Limited manufactures and sells bearings, bushes, and related components, with significant transactions with its holding company NRB Bearings Limited.
facts.related_party_note: Material related party transactions approved with holding company NRB Bearings Limited for purchase/sale of raw materials, finished goods, components, consumables, bushes, machinery, equipment, tools, fixed assets, and reimbursement of expenses/services estimated at Rs. 40 crores for FY 2026-27.
